people.imagined: Dawn at the edge of the northern woods, the night of asking over. He lays a palm on the bark one last time and the tree has said yes. The axe is on his back; the heartwood disc at his throat is warm. He is slow, certain, and waiting.
people.subject: The moment: at first light, in a hall of ancient pines wrapped in silver mist, he lays one broad palm flat on the bark of a huge dark tree and turns his head to the viewer, listening; the tree has said yes. Face (most important: the grey beard and a pale disc of heartwood at the throat): a big, slow, heavy-boned face with a wide nose and a long full grey beard cut square at the chest, a pale old scar running across the left cheek into the beard; deep-set grey eyes under bushy grey brows, the skin weathered brown with fine lines. Hair: thick grey, gathered in a high knot at the crown and crowned with a circlet of carved dark wood set with a small jade leaf. Body: tall and very broad, with a slow, immovable bearing. Clothing: the head of the house in its richest dress: three crossed collars of bark-brown and deep forest-green silk with a soft sheen, wooden toggles carved like acorns, collars embroidered with oak leaves in dull gold thread, a dark green gauze over-robe with whole trees embroidered down its wide sleeves, a green silk sash hung with jade pendants. Behind his right shoulder rises the long haft of a felling axe worn like a sceptre. Hands and objects: the right hand flat on the bark; at his throat on a silk cord a round disc of pale golden heartwood the size of a plum, glowing warmly. Power: a deep jade-green aura gathers around him like canopy shade, motes of green light drifting up from his shoulders as if the tree answered him. Background: dark trunks of old pines in grey mist. Light: pale gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left through the trunks, a soft green rim light on the beard and shoulders. Expression: a slow, level gaze with the mouth quiet inside the beard, brows relaxed, the head tilted a little as if listening to the bark.

people.imagined: Spring flood morning on the river, shouting orders to the rafts behind. The green banner is rolled under her arm; her son is on her mind and she shouts louder.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a raft of lashed spirit logs in the spray of the spring flood, she shouts over her shoulder to the rafts behind, one hand cupped at her mouth, her son on her mind so that she shouts louder. Face (most important: hands scarred by river ropes, held up beside the face): a wide, weathered brown face with a big mouth open in a shout, strong white teeth, laugh lines, a thick scar through the right brow, wind-reddened cheeks and bright dark eyes. Hair: black with iron-grey streaks, in a thick braid wrapped twice round the head and tied with a green cord, fastened with a carved dark-wood hairpin, a few wet strands stuck at the temples. Body: strong and square-shouldered, braced against the sway of the logs. Clothing: as an elder of the house, a short bark-brown silk coat with a soft sheen and acorn toggles, the sleeves pushed to the elbow, over a deep blue under-robe with a collar embroidered with oak leaves, and a dark green gauze over-vest with small embroidered trees drifting in the spray; a green silk sash with a jade pendant at the waist. The bare forearms are white-scarred with rope marks. Hands and objects: the right hand cupped at the mouth with rope scars crisscrossing palm and wrist; under her left arm a rolled green banner of heavy silk tied with a cord. Power: a restless wash of blue-green qi swirls at her feet with the flood, and drops of water hang glowing in the air around her. Background: white river water and lashed logs under a pearl-grey sky, the near rafts crowded with small figures. Light: bright cold silver spirit-light from the upper left, spray glittering in it, a pale rim light on her wet hair. Expression: a loud, impatient, fearless shout, the brows drawn down and the grin tight, with worry showing in the eyes behind the bravado.

people.imagined: He is pulling off one bark-glove to reckon a coin, rings showing, with a ledger-calm smile. He has just decided the lord's wood-keeper is a fool.
people.subject: The moment: in a log yard under green forest light, he slowly draws a glove from his right hand, showing three heavy rings, and looks at the viewer with a handsome knowing smile, having just decided the lord's wood-keeper is a fool. Face (most important: the merchant's rings, one gold and two jade, on the bare fingers): a handsome sharp face with a high forehead, a narrow nose and a neat thin moustache, bright restless brown eyes, a mouth curved in a smile that does not reach the eyes; clear skin, a small gold stud in the left ear. Hair: glossy black, tied up in a neat high knot with a green silk cord and a silver hairpin. Body: lean and tall, relaxed, a little too well kept for a warden. Clothing: a long robe of bark-brown silk with a soft sheen, two crossed collars embroidered with oak leaves, the cuffs lined in dark green silk, a sash of green silk with a brass-and-jade buckle and a coil of tally cord at the hip; wooden toggles carved like acorns down the front, better cloth than any other warden's. Hands and objects: the right glove, oiled brown silk-leather, half off; on the bare fingers a gold ring and two jade rings; the left hand holding the glove cuff. Power: only a faint shimmer of green qi on the jade rings. Background: a log yard in dim green spirit mist, stacked pale logs fading into the dark. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left, a soft rim light on the cheek and the rings. Expression: greedy and sure of himself; charm over contempt.

people.imagined: A night beside a spirit tree, her palm on the bark, her face turned up to hear it. People lean toward her when she speaks. Moss grows on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: at night in a forest of glowing trunks, one palm held against a spirit tree, her head tilted back as if listening, eyes half closed; people always lean toward her when she speaks. Face: a thin, pale oval face with hollow cheeks, a long fine nose, heavy calm eyelids, dark brows, a very small mouth slightly parted as if about to whisper, pale dry lips, small ears and fine lines of concentration across the forehead; the skin cool and pale. Hair: long black hair streaked with grey, loose over both shoulders, a few strands of moss tangled in it, held back by a plain dark-wood comb. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered and bent slightly forward toward the trunk. Clothing (the moss is the lead): a steward's long robe of bark-brown silk with wide sleeves whose cuffs and shoulders are furred with thick green tufts of living moss, tiny ferns and a few pale mushrooms growing in the silk; a pale under-robe with an oak-leaf embroidered collar, a grey silk sash, the hem dark with damp earth; no hat. Hands and objects: the right hand pressed flat on rough dark bark; the left hangs mossy at her side with a small embroidered bag of seed husks on the wrist. Power: a thin green-gold glow gathers on the bark under her palm and a few motes of green light rise along her arm. Background: giant dark trunks with a faint pale-green glow in the bark, night mist, a ring of bracket fungi climbing the trunk like shelves and a single owl on a high bough. Light: cool moonlight from the upper left, the green-gold glow lighting her palm and wrist. Expression: a quiet, absorbed devotion, lips parted and brow smooth, the face of someone who listens more than she speaks.

people.imagined: In the hornet valley, a hornet resting on his shoulder, welts in beads along his neck. The birds are quiet. He smiles slowly at a poacher who is not there.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a green valley haze, two big yellow-banded hornets crawling on his shoulder and one on his cheek, he smiles slowly at the viewer, as at a poacher who is not there, while the birds fall quiet. Face (most important: a string of red swollen welts running in beads up both sides of the neck and along the jaw): a long gaunt face with a hooked nose, pale skin dotted with red hornet welts, small dark half-lidded eyes and a thin smile with one corner pulled up. Hair: black, long and unkempt, tied at the nape with a strip of dull green silk. Body: tall, lean and stooped, calm and loose in the shoulders, perfectly still. Clothing: a long robe of bark-brown silk with a high collar worn open, a second collar of forest green beneath embroidered with oak leaves, a hornet-veil hat of fine brown straw with the black gauze veil pushed up on the brim, a green silk sash carrying several small clay pots stoppered with wax, acorn toggles at the chest. Hands and objects: bare hands held open and still at chest height, a big yellow-and-black hornet resting on the back of one. Power: a faint green-gold shimmer of qi hangs around him, and the hornets drift in it like sparks. Background: a deep green valley, pale paper-like nests hanging in the branches, a few more hornets in the haze. Light: green-filtered spirit-light from the upper left through the leaves, dappled on his face and the welts, a pale rim light on the veil. Expression: a slow, delighted half-smile with one corner of the mouth lifted and the eyelids low, calm and quietly cruel.

people.imagined: He sits with tally-sticks over his knees and lays his hands flat on them so no one sees the tremor. His parents are alive and he is ten years from dying of age.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a quiet hall, he presses both hands flat on a bundle of notched sticks across his knees, as if to hold them still so no one sees the tremor, and smiles gently at the viewer; he is old, his parents still living, and ten years from dying of age. Face: a long, kind, tired face with dry, very pale, lined skin, age spots on the temples, deep creases down the cheeks, a thin neat white moustache and soft grey eyes, sunken, with heavy lids; he looks decades older than his father. Hair: thin white hair tied in a small knot with a plain wooden pin. Body: thin and slightly bent with narrow shoulders, sitting very upright from habit. Clothing: a steward's clean robe of bark-brown silk a little too big for him, with crossed collars edged in faded green, acorn toggles at the front, a thick grey silk shawl over the shoulders, sleeves long enough to cover the wrists. Hands and objects: both hands lie flat and spread on a bundle of about twenty narrow wooden tally-sticks, each notched on one side; the knuckles white and the fingers faintly blurred with trembling. Power: only the faintest pale green glimmer in the air, thin as breath. Background: a warm dark timber wall with a shelf of other bundles of sticks tied with green cord, lamplit mist at the edges. Light: soft window light like moonlight from the upper left, warm on the pale skin and the white hair, a gentle rim light along the shoulder. Expression: a courteous, patient smile, honest and resigned, the soft eyes steady while the hands shake, accepting what is coming without complaint.

people.imagined: She has been wading in the forest bog to look for a seedling; mud to the knee, wet hair, grey eyes. She holds up a bit of green she hopes is one.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a wet forest clearing wreathed in mist, she lifts a tiny green sprout between two muddy fingers toward the viewer, hopeful and stubborn after wading in the bog for a seedling. Face (most important: wide, pale grey eyes, bright and steady, like her grandfather's): a round freckled face with a square little chin, straight brows, a short nose, a firm mouth with a small cut healing on the lower lip, chapped lips, and a splash of mud across the right cheek. Hair: dark brown, in two thick braids pinned up and tied with green silk cord, escaping in curls, a sprig of bright green fern tucked behind one ear. Body: small and sturdy, balanced on her heels. Clothing: the plain graceful version for a beginner: a short robe of bark-brown silk hitched up at the belt, the wide sleeves rolled, a collar with small oak leaves, a green sash, the hem and trousers dark with bog mud to the knee, clean silk beneath. Hands and objects: the right hand holding a hair-thin green seedling with two leaves, roots dripping mud; the left supports a small embroidered bag. Power: none beyond the sprout itself, whose two leaves glow a soft living green. Background: a wet forest floor of ferns, fallen branches and thick moss, thin young firs rising in a pale line through blue-grey mist. Light: cool spirit-light from the upper left, a single shaft falling on the sprout, a soft rim light on her wet braids. Expression: a determined, hopeful look, the jaw set and the grey eyes wide and unwavering, brave and a little stubborn.

people.imagined: He turns his right hand palm up to look at the callus; the axe is leaning on the log at his side. He wants to ride the rafts and has not yet asked twice.
people.subject: The moment: he holds his right hand open toward the viewer, palm up, showing a hard yellow callus across it, and gazes at it with a serious face. Face: a lean young face, high cheekbones, dark steady eyes beneath straight brows, a wide plain mouth held tight, a tuft of black fuzz on the chin; skin sun-browned. A scar like a white hook marks his chin, and a trace of sawdust dusts his eyebrows. Hair: black and short, a green silk band round the forehead. Body: wiry, big-handed, upright. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of bark-brown silk with a green-edged collar, the left sleeve long and buttoned with a wooden acorn toggle at the wrist, the right sleeve rolled in four neat folds to the elbow; a plain silk sash holding a small wooden wedge. Hands and objects (the callus is the lead): the right hand held up, the base of the fingers and the palm thick with a yellow horny callus, every crease showing; the left hand bare and smooth; behind him a short felling axe leaning on a log. Power: none; only a faint calm. Background: stacked pale logs in a forest yard fading into dark mist, a stump with a clean pale top and a thin line of dark woods above. Light: clear pale spirit-light from the upper left lying flat across his open palm, a soft rim light on the cheekbone. Expression: a serious, lowered gaze on the callus, lips pressed together, a hard quiet gathered in the eyes and a faint tension in the jaw.

people.imagined: He is leaning on the hoe in the seedbed, his back bent into the same curve as the tool; a seedling bed in rows behind. He will stay as long as he likes.
people.subject: The moment: an old man leans on a long-handled hoe in a seedbed, his whole back bent in a curve to match it, looking up at the viewer from under his brow; he will stay as long as he likes. Face (most important: the back bent like the hoe, the shoulders high and the head thrust forward): a small brown wrinkled face with a snub nose, a wispy white beard of a dozen long hairs with a few tiny seeds clinging to it, watery kind eyes, a cheerful toothless mouth, long soft ears, a forehead creased like old leather and earth in the lines of the face. Hair: thin white, under a plain bark-brown silk cap. Body: very small and bent nearly double, thin arms and knotty knuckles. Clothing: an outer disciple's robe, clean, soft with age and well kept: bark-brown silk with a faded green collar, a dark green silk belt, trousers rolled to the shin, bare feet with soil between the toes, a wide straw hat hanging down his back by its cord. Hands and objects: both gnarled hands on the long wooden handle of an iron hoe nearly the same bent shape as he is. Power: none, only a few soft golden-green motes rising from the dark soil around his feet. Background: rows of tiny green seedlings in black soil under a neat wooden frame, a timber fence, and a watering gourd on a small stool, dim in morning mist. Light: soft pearly morning spirit-light from the upper left that rims the curve of his back like a drawn line. Expression: an untroubled, toothless smile, content and patient, the eyes watery and warm, a man who has stood in this bed for a very long time and feels no hurry.

people.imagined: He has just been shouted awake on the raft deck; his hair is flattened on one side, he grins sleepily with a rope in his hand.
people.subject: The moment: he sits on a log raft with a rope slack in one hand, just shouted awake, blinking and grinning sleepily at the viewer. Face (most important: the hair, flattened to one side with a sticking-up tuft on top): a round, easy, sunburned face, droopy-lidded dark eyes, a wide sleepy grin, thick brows, a crease from his sleeve on the left cheek, cheeks flushed pink with sleep, a few days' stubble round the chin. Hair: black, one side flat as if slept on, a stiff tuft standing at the crown. Body: broad and soft, relaxed, barefoot. Clothing: an outer disciple's easy robe of bark-brown silk left open over a loose pale silk shirt open at the neck, one sleeve rolled higher than the other, a loose green silk-cord belt, trousers rolled, bare feet on wet logs; a flat straw hat on the log beside him. Hands and objects: a thick wet hemp rope trailing from one hand, a half-tied knot dangling. Power: none. Background: a wide pearl-grey river with mist lying on it, logs lashed in neat rows with thick hemp lines, a few other rafts drifting far off, a heron on a post. Light: warm gold morning spirit-light from the upper left, sparkling on the water and making his hair tuft glow at the edges. Expression: a sleepy lopsided grin, heavy lids half closed, cheeks creased, the whole face loose and unhurried.

people.imagined: Before dawn at the spring, she kneels to a bowl; dew still hangs on her lashes and the hem of her coat is soaked. She is gentle and not afraid of the dark.
people.subject: The moment: before dawn she kneels at a small spring pool with a wide shallow bowl of clear water in both hands and looks up at the viewer with wet lashes. Face (most important: tiny drops of dew on her lashes, glittering): a soft round gentle face, big clear brown eyes with long lashes each holding a bead of dew, a small straight nose, rosy cheeks flushed from the cold, a calm half-smile, fine dark brows and a fine tracery of dew at her hairline. Hair: long black hair in a single loose braid over her shoulder, tied with a green silk ribbon, damp with mist. Body: slim and small, kneeling. Clothing: an outer disciple's graceful robe of bark-brown silk in a smaller size, the hem and knees dark and soaked, a pale under-robe wet through at the wrists, a collar with tiny oak-leaf embroidery, a green silk sash tied in a simple bow with long loose ends, a hornet-veil hat of straw hanging behind her neck on its cord. Hands and objects: a wide shallow clay bowl full of clear water with a single reflected star, held on her palms at chest height. Power: a few soft green-white motes of qi lift from the water like fireflies. Background: a dim spring pool among ferns, pale blue dawn mist, white flowers floating on the dark water, a stream running away to the left. Light: blue pre-dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a ring of pale light edging the bowl's rim and each dew bead holding a point of light. Expression: a calm, open face tilted up, soft parted lips and wide steady eyes beaded with dew on the lashes.

people.imagined: In a plain room, with the rolled green banner over his shoulder as always, he folds a letter he signed in his master's name and tucks it away, smiling blandly.
people.subject: The moment: in a plain lamplit room, he stands with a long rolled green banner on his shoulder as always and tucks a folded letter, signed in his master's name, into his robe with a bland smile. Face: a plain, tidy, middle-aged face with a long jaw, a short wispy moustache carefully trimmed at both ends, small bright eyes that dart a little, even features, slightly large ears and a small cleft in the chin; skin reddish with river weather. Hair: black, in a tight top-knot with a green silk cord and a plain silver pin. Body: medium height, spare, a straight carrier's back. Clothing: a steward's clean robe of bark-brown silk with sharp pressed folds, two crossed collars, a green silk sash exactly centred, a clean pale under-robe at the neck; trousers rolled over bare shins, bare feet on the boards. Hands and objects: a long rolled banner of green silk, thick as a man's thigh, tied with a cord in a neat double knot, laid over the right shoulder and gripped with the right hand; the left hand slipping a small folded sheet into the robe. Power: none beyond a faint steady calm. Background: a bare timber wall in shadow, a rack of long banner poles in the corner, a small shrine shelf holding a clay cup. Light: soft window light from the upper left like pale moonlight, a faint warm line across his robe and the banner's folds. Expression: loyal and brave on top, a flicker of the deceitful in the glance.

people.imagined: At the roadside she watches a cart go by and prices each wheel with her eyes; her mind is already on the eastern woods selling past the lord.
people.subject: The moment: at a forest roadside she looks sideways at a cart rolling past, eyes calculating, her head slightly turned, already thinking of the eastern woods selling past the lord. Face: a narrow, pointed, attractive face, level assessing grey-green eyes narrow with long lashes, thin brows arched high, a small calm mouth shut and coloured a pale rose; a cool unreadable expression, a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot at the nape with a green silk cord, not one hair loose, held by a slim silver pin. Body: slender and straight, composed. Clothing: a well-fitted warden's robe of bark-brown silk with tightly cuffed sleeves lined at the cuffs with a thin strip of dark green silk, crossed collars embroidered with oak leaves, a dark silk belt with a neat tally pouch and a short coil of tally cord, a hornet-veil hat held by its cord at her hip; clean boots freshly oiled. Hands and objects: her right hand shades her eyes; the left rests on the pouch at her belt. Power: a faint jade-green shimmer along her cuffs, restrained. Background: a dusty forest road in drifting mist, a wooden cart wheel leaning on a post in the foreground, a long line of tall dark trees closing the far side. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, her face half in light and half in the dappled shade of a branch, a thin rim light on the pale cheek. Expression: a flat, appraising stare with narrowed eyes and a closed, unmoved mouth, brows level and guarded.

people.imagined: Working the seedbeds in the soft morning, a husk tucked behind each ear, she kneels beside the old man and thumbs the earth around a sprout.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a seedbed in soft morning mist with soil on her hands, she looks up from a small sprout with a mild smile. Face (most important: a pale seed-husk tucked behind each ear, one on either side, plain to see): a round, calm, freckled face with a small mouth and kind slightly tilted brown eyes, thin level brows, a smudge of soil on the chin, a pale husk the size of a thumbnail behind each ear and a few seeds caught in the hair above her forehead. Hair: black in two low braids looped under the ears (the husks tucked beside them), a green silk thread in each. Body: slight, patient, kneeling. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of bark-brown silk with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, forearms dark with soil, a pale under-robe, a green silk sash with a small wooden dibber tucked in, the hem wet and dark. Hands and objects: both hands pressed into dark soil around a tiny green sprout; a small embroidered bag of seeds at her wrist. Power: none, only a few tiny green motes lifting from the sprout. Background: neat dark rows of seedlings and a log fence, a thin wooden label stick at the head of each row, a rain barrel and a stack of baskets in the haze. Light: soft cool-gold early spirit-light from the upper left on the damp soil, the husks behind her ears glowing pale. Expression: a mild, gentle smile and soft eyes lifted from the sprout, the face open and unhurried.

people.imagined: She sings on the river as the rafts pass, plain and proud of it; heads turn on the banks. She has the wide-open mouth of a singer.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot on a raft on a wide silver river, she sings with her head thrown back and her mouth open, one hand on her chest, and heads turn on the banks. Face (most important: a very plain face, as she says herself, with a wide mouth open in song): a broad flat face with small narrow eyes and a snub nose, heavy cheeks, uneven brows with one higher than the other, a broad chin with a deep cleft, a big mouth open wide in song showing square white teeth, blotchy sunburnt skin and a flush on her sun-reddened nose; plain and honest, and not softened. Hair: coarse brown, in one thick braid tied with a green silk cord, loose strands blown. Body: sturdy, big-boned. Clothing: an outer disciple's robe of bark-brown silk tied open over a plain pale silk shirt, sleeves rolled to show strong arms, trousers rolled, bare feet on the logs, a green sash tied with a big flat bow, a small wooden whistle on a silk cord at her neck. Hands and objects: right hand flat on her chest; the left stretched out toward the far bank. Power: a few faint motes of blue-green light drift from her open mouth as if the song itself were visible. Background: a wide silver river, pale logs and a line of green hills in mist, flat-bottomed boats and a stone landing on the far bank with a few small blurred figures waving. Light: bright pearly river spirit-light from the upper left picking out her wide cheekbones, a soft rim light on her throat. Expression: a wide-open singing mouth, eyes shut or lifted to the sky, throat taut, cheeks flushed with plain joy.

people.imagined: At night in the hornet valley he takes the honey, unbothered by the buzzing around him. The gourds clink at his belt and welts rest under both eyes.
people.subject: The moment: at night in the hornet valley, he reaches calmly into a hollow with hornets crawling around his face and looks at the viewer, taking the honey, unbothered by the buzzing. Face (most important: red welts under both eyes, swollen into two puffy crescents): a young, thin, quiet face with two red puffy welts beneath dark calm eyes, a long nose, hair-fine eyebrows, two small white scars across the lower lip, faint pale stings dotting the temples and two hornets walking on his cheek. Hair: black and short, cut unevenly. Body: lean, still and deliberate, shoulders low. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bark-brown silk with the sleeves tied at the wrists with leather cords, a green collar embroidered with oak leaves, a hornet-veil hat of fine straw with the dark gauze veil flipped up and folded at the back, gloves tucked in his silk belt, and a row of five small brown gourds hung by cords at his belt, clinking. Hands and objects: the right hand, bare, reaching into a wax-grey hive hollow dripping golden honey; the left holds an open gourd. Power: a faint green-gold shimmer of qi on his hand where the honey glows. Background: a dark valley with waxy grey nests hanging from the branches like paper lanterns, a faint amber glow, honey dripping in slow gold threads from a split in the bark. Light: moonlight from the upper left, the warm amber glow of the honey lighting his face from below, the hornets' wings showing like tiny glass. Expression: a calm, unafraid, withdrawn face, the eyes half lidded and the mouth quiet, a man more at home among hornets than people.

people.imagined: He is fidgeting with a notched stick while he thinks about the 1199 tally and the notch that matches no log. He has not asked.
people.subject: The moment: he turns a notched tally-stick over and over in his fingers, frowning down at it over the 1199 tally and the notch that matches no log, then glances up at the viewer; he has not asked. Face: a thin, honest, serious young face, a high forehead with a crease, narrow dark eyes behind a small tidy frown, a straight nose, a clean-shaven chin, a long thin neck, ink on the fingertips, slight shadows under the eyes and a faint pinch at the bridge of the nose from habitual frowning. Hair: black, parted and tied tight in a small top-knot with a plain green silk cord and a wooden pin. Body: slim, upright, careful. Clothing: an inner disciple's neat robe of bark-brown silk buttoned fully with acorn toggles, sleeves exactly the same length and buttoned at the wrist, a clean pale under-collar, a green silk sash tied flat, a small wooden brush and a knife for notching hanging from his belt; a bundle of twenty tally-sticks under the left arm. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a single notched stick of pale wood between thumb and forefinger at chest height, the notches plain and clear. Power: none beyond a faint calm. Background: a dim timber wall with pegs, a shelf of tally-sticks sorted by size and a low lamp burning beside a writing board, mist at the edges. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left like gold spirit-light, sharp shadows below his chin and in the notches of the stick, a soft rim light on the cheek. Expression: a puzzled frown with the brow drawn together and the mouth pulled slightly to one side, eyes lifting warily from the stick.

people.imagined: He grins a crooked grin that never reaches his eyes, counting a copper in his palm while he talks.
people.subject: The moment: he grins sideways at the viewer with a square-holed copper coin flipped between his fingers, eyes cold above the smile, counting a copper while he talks. Face (most important: a split upper lip, an old scar splitting the lip upward to the nostril, and a crooked one-sided grin): a narrow lean face, a clearly split lip with a pink raised scar running from the lip into the left nostril, a crooked grin that shows one crooked tooth, flat watchful eyes that do not smile, a sharp little chin, slightly pointed ears, thin eyebrows, a faint scatter of spots on the nose and a sheen of sweat at the temples. Hair: black, cropped and uneven, a green silk band across the brow. Body: wiry, quick, thin. Clothing: an outer disciple's robe of bark-brown silk a little too big for him, the sleeves cut off short at the elbows, a clean pale under-shirt, a silk belt with a copper-coin purse stitched with thick red thread. Hands and objects: a single square-holed copper coin held between the right thumb and forefinger, raised near his shoulder, glinting. Power: none. Background: stacks of pale logs lying numbered with tiny chalk marks fading into pale mist, a rope sling hanging from a beam, a gap of sky. Light: bright pale spirit-light from the upper left, a glint on the coin and a sharp line on his split lip. Expression: a crooked, practised grin on the mouth while the eyes stay cold and flat, one brow just raised.

people.imagined: Memorial of the sworn brother standing over a felled spirit log in the winter of 990 against the bears, a stout staff in his hands, waiting for his brother.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an elder standing guard in the snow over a pale felled spirit log in the winter of 990 against the bears, a stout staff in his hands, waiting for his sworn brother. Face: a broad, open, ruddy face with a short black beard flecked with snow, thick brows, steady brown eyes looking forward, a broad nose, red cold cheeks, a wide determined mouth and snowflakes resting on the eyelashes. Hair: black, tied in a knot and covered by a fur-trimmed hat with a small crown-band of carved dark wood. Body: stocky, very broad, planted wide-legged in the snow. Clothing: an elder's long robe of bark-brown silk lined with grey fur, buttoned with dark wooden acorn toggles, a dark green gauze over-robe embroidered with whole snow-laden trees, a thick fur hood hanging back from the shoulders, a thick green silk sash with a jade pendant, heavy boots with snow clinging to the trousers to the knee, gloves on each hand. Hands and objects: both hands grip a stout ash staff planted upright before him; behind him a thick pale spirit log glows faintly, half covered in snow. Power: a faint pale green glow around him like frost-light, drifting motes among the snowflakes. Background: a winter forest of dark pines, falling snow and a pale dim sky, broken branches around the log and the shapes of bears only hinted as shadows between the pines at the far edge. Light: a cold pale spirit-light from the upper left, fading like old paint, the yellowed silk darkening at the corners and fine cracks running across the face like old lacquer. Expression: a firm, calm smile, steady and warm, the face of a man who laughs easily and is content to wait as long as it takes.
